ratings_why.fun: Two opposite builds on one Heat gauge give a real decision every turn and a strong mid-to-late climb, but Tier 1 is thin and the prompt count is high.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because busting is itself a payoff: a Seized unit comes back Tagged and replays its When played on rebuy, so no today's tribe or generic auto-battler plays a push-your-luck turn like this.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken or unreadable; what is left is the owner's tuning of Old Wick, Nan and the early seeds.

points.text: Holt Kit grows nothing until you make two Runs a turn, and Tier 1 has only Tibby's one Run. Giving +1/+1 for any Clean turn, plus the per-two-Runs gain, would let the seed start on turn 2.
Say whether a Seized unit (or Grisel's copy) takes one of the shop's slots or sits in an extra one; it changes how much a bust costs your roll.
Old Wick with Gran's Limit 9 and Squacco's reset can see 5 or 6 clean Runs, about 70 stats a turn at Tier 5. Hot and fun; worth the owner's eye when balancing.
The Hot build's in-fight gain is all Attack. Officer Nyx giving +1 Health per two Heat would let it survive Bristle and Cleave boards without changing its job.
Nan counts every Run this game, so the Back channel build with Creel-Weaver feeds her most; golden Nan reaches about +120/+120 late. Linear, so a high roll, not a runaway.

standouts.why: Sergeant Squacco turns a bust into a choice: he takes the seizure, cools you and comes back Tagged.
Close-Shave Creeler's double at exactly the Limit makes the near miss the skill test.
Slipway Champion is a push-your-luck game in one card, and Seizing it on purpose to replay it is a great trick.

weakest.why: Holt Kit is dead in the turns a Tier 1 seed should start growing.
Bell-Diver Gran is a Tier 4 slot with no stats of its own; only good once the build is set.
Salt-Pan Runner's 1 gold a turn is flat and does little for either build.

flags.note: Old Wick with a raised Limit and Squacco's reset runs well above the Tier 5 guide.
Hackle plus Squacco is a every-turn loop: bust on purpose, rebuy Squacco for 2 with a Tag, buff the team. Linear but cheap.
Thousand-Channel Pilot with Creel-Weaver or Moss brings two or more units a tier up each turn and may pull the curve a tier early.
Golden Nan late in a Run-heavy game is very large; linear in Runs.
